te: In Dorchester, Massachusetts, John Winthrop takes the oath of office and becomes the first Governor of Massachusetts.
dz: 在马萨诸塞州多切斯特,约翰·温斯罗普宣誓就职并成为马萨诸塞州首任州长.

te: The city of Magdeburg in Germany is seized by forces of the Holy Roman Empire and most of its inhabitants massacred, in…
dz: 德国的马格德堡市被神圣罗马帝国军队所夺取并被其大部分居民屠杀,这是三十年战争中最血腥的事件之一.
de: The city of Magdeburg in Germany is seized by forces of the Holy Roman Empire and most of its inhabitants massacred, in one of the bloodiest incidents of the Thirty Years' War.

dz: 穆姆塔兹·马哈尔在分娩时死亡. 她的丈夫莫卧儿皇帝沙·贾汉一世将花17年时间来建造她的陵墓"泰姬陵".
de: Mumtaz Mahal dies during childbirth. Her husband, Mughal emperor Shah Jahan I, will spend the next 17 years building her mausoleum, the Taj Mahal.

dz: 巴尔的摩的沙克:巴尔的摩的爱尔兰村庄被巴巴里奴隶商人所攻击.

dz: 瑞典在三十年战争中于布雷滕费尔德对神圣罗马帝国的战役中取得重大胜利.
